description: Create an interactive bot conversation with buttons. When triggered, shows a message with clickable button options that lead to different responses.

reply_text.description: Auto-reply text when this button is pressed

channels.description: Optional. Channels this rule replies on, e.g. ["instagram", "messenger"]. Omit or [] = every channel (default). "whatsapp" covers both official and unofficial WhatsApp numbers. On other channels the message falls through to the other rules, the default reply or the AI.

text.description: Message body that appears with the buttons

title.description: Header title for the interactive message

name: create_interactive_conversation
